summary: First full E2E run of the ERP Service Auto core (backend pytest with 26 tests + Playwright UI for all 16 requested flows). Found one CRITICAL bug: POST /api/work-orders/{id}/quotes always returned 500 because of a MongoDB update conflict ($push quotes + $set quotes.$[o].status in one update). Testing agent FIXED it in routes_service.py.create_quote by splitting it into two updates. After the fix the whole lifecycle works in API and UI: reception (5 photos + signature) -> CL-2026-NNNNN -> labor/part lines (rate from settings, VAT 21%) -> quote v1/v2 (supersede) -> send email (simulated) -> approve with signature (in-app + public /approve/{token}) -> timer start (In lucru) -> Finalizata blocked before QC -> QC passed -> Finalizata -> fiscal invoice (FIFO COGS correct: 10@40+2@60=520, stock decreased) -> XML CIUS-RO download -> SPV submit/refresh (mocked) -> partial/full payment CH-xxxxxx, overpay rejected -> cash register -> close WO. RBAC, login/logout, dashboard KPIs + charts, CRM validations, vehicles, kanban drag&drop, stock/NIR/avg cost/low filter, mechanics clock in/out + month filter, users CRUD + audit, settings, all 6 print pages, AI OBD streaming (Gemini) and RO/EN + dark/light toggles all pass. Remaining issue: brute-force lockout does not work behind the ingress.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT. Returned 500 every time: pymongo WriteError 'Updating the path quotes.$[o].status would create a conflict at quotes' ($push + $set with array_filters on the same array in one update_one). Split into two updates (supersede first, then push).

Brute-force lockout can be bypassed. The identifier is f'{request.client.host}:{email}' and request.client.host is the ingress pod IP, which changes between requests (10.79.138.2 / 10.79.138.5 seen), so failed attempts get split across several keys and 6+ bad logins never return 429. Use the first IP in X-Forwarded-For (or key on email only).

minor.issue: Email in the body is ignored (cannot change a user's email) and is not checked for uniqueness. No 404 for an unknown uid.
Part lines take vat_rate from settings instead of the product's own vat_rate. There is no stock-availability check, so consume_fifo can drive stock_qty negative.
q is passed to $regex without re.escape (regex injection / crash on input like '(').
Approving an older quote while the WO is in_lucru/asteapta_piese/finalizata sets the status back to 'aprobata'.

Company data is still placeholders ([Denumire Service Auto] SRL, RO[CUI], J[XX]/[nr]/[an], RO[IBAN]). These appear on every print document and in the e-Factura XML. Real ANAF validation would reject the CUI.

ui_bugs.issue: The Gemini markdown answer is shown as raw text (###, ** visible). Render it with react-markdown or similar.

issues: Line prices and amounts are not formatted consistently (e.g. '180', '270', '56,7', '100' next to '27.984,88'). Use money/2-decimal formatting.
Buyer block shows a stray ',' when the address and city are empty.
Address shows ', (RO-B)' when empty. The vehicle shows 'VW Golf ()' / 'Dacia Logan ·' when the year is missing.
Only about 7 columns fit, so the last column needs horizontal scroll. Acceptable, but no scroll hint is shown.

design_issues.screen: NIR dialog, reception promised date, cash day, mechanics month
issues: These use the browser's native date/month inputs instead of a shadcn Calendar/date picker.
Columns are squeezed and text wraps heavily. Consider a card layout or horizontal scroll.

action_items: Fix brute-force lockout identifier: use the X-Forwarded-For client IP (first entry) or the email alone, so 5 failed attempts give 429.
Render AI answers as markdown in AiAssistant.js.
Format numbers in PrintDoc (invoice lines, cash register amounts) with the money helper and remove the stray comma for empty addresses.

Optional: escape regex in /work-orders q, use the product's vat_rate for part lines, guard against negative stock, block status regression on approving an old quote, allow email update with a uniqueness check in PUT /users.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_service.create_quote: the mixed $push/$set on the 'quotes' path is a hard Mongo conflict (fixed).
routes_auth.login: request.client.host behind the K8s ingress is not the real client IP.
routes_stock.consume_fifo: no transaction. Concurrent invoices can double-consume lots. Consider find_one_and_update per lot or a Mongo transaction.
routes_finance.create_payment: read-then-write on paid_amount with no atomic guard. Two concurrent payments could overpay. Use a conditional update ($expr paid_amount + amount <= gross).
Fiscal invoice numbering via counters is fine, but the invoice is inserted after FIFO consumption. If the insert fails, stock is consumed without an invoice.
PUT /settings accepts an arbitrary dict with no Pydantic validation (vat_rate could be set to a string).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass (after quote fix)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@serviceauto.ro / Admin2026!; demo users password Demo2026! (works). bcrypt hashes start with $2b$. httpOnly secure samesite=none cookies are set. CORS echoes the explicit origin with credentials=true. seed_admin updates the admin hash if the password changed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ clients/vehicles/WOs/invoices/payments/products/NIRs/users during tests and then deleted all of them via mongosh. Side effects: the invoice/receipt/NIR/WO counters advanced (numbering gaps: SRV000066-67, CH-000018-20, CL-2026-00075..77, NIR-2026-00005..09 removed). Labor rates restored to their original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_erp_core.py -n 0 (MUST use -n 0, because the tests share module-level STATE across classes and xdist loadscope splits them). Signature pads are canvases: draw with page.mouse down/move/up. Photo inputs: set_input_files on [data-testid=reception-photo-{k}-input] with a buffer. In the NIR dialog, suppliers load lazily, so wait for options before selecting. Kanban drag_to works on [data-testid=kanban-card-{number}] -> [data-testid=kanban-col-{status}].
rca of the issue: Quote 500: MongoDB rejects one update that both $push-es to 'quotes' and $set-s 'quotes.$[o].status' (error code 40, path conflict). Reproduce: POST /api/work-orders/{id}/quotes on any WO with lines. Fix: two sequential update_one calls. Lockout bypass: the login_attempts identifier uses the proxy IP, which rotates across ingress pods (verified in the DB: the same email was split across 10.79.138.2 and 10.79.138.5 with counts 4+2). Fix: derive the IP from the X-Forwarded-For header.
